title: RGS Tool Autoinvoke MS1 — Integration hardening + backlog
brief: Fix the 10 P0 integration bugs the MS0 post-ship audit found (the real reader factories were never end-to-end tested), then work the validated MS1 backlog: nightly replan, domain rules, dispatcher wiring, feedback forcing, RIE adapter, calibration, transfer priors.

units.title: Fix 10 P0 integration bugs + real-data E2E oracle
units.description: MS0 shipped 97 unit tests that injected FAKE readers; every P0 lived in the orchestrator's REAL reader factories, untested end-to-end. Fixes P0-1 (tribal reader {hits} destructure + h.title), P0-2 (ollama bridge IPv4 default), P0-3 (ollama reader timeoutMs), P0-4 (capabilities reader tokenize-per-token), P0-5 (drop /forge-triple boilerplate over-fire), P0-6a/b/c (feedback loop: flat sidecar read, composite-key split, tier+verdict outcome-record contract), P0-7 (coverage flat-source read), P0-8 (rgs.md route handlers), P0-9 (BUILD_STATE re-snapshot), P0-10 (stop-hook git timeout 8000->2500ms). Adds scripts/rgs-tool-planner.e2e.test.mjs — the real-data regression oracle (11 failing assertions on buggy code -> 84/84 green).

phases.title: MS1 backlog (validated by the post-ship audit)

units.title: Nightly cron replan
units.description: Windows scheduled task running the planner + Ollama with --time-budget. Without it the sidecar rots; everything downstream depends on live Ollama-synth plans. Pattern: install-fleet-reaper-task.ps1.

units.title: Domain pipeline rules + skill triggers
units.description: Add mill/lathe/wedm/cam/cad pipeline rules to rgs-pipeline-rules.mjs (only 7 rules today -> 42% generic fallback). Register manufacturing-domain skills in _skill-triggers.jsonl (38 harness skills, ZERO domain skills today). Plus the punch-list 'Wire EDM false-matches /wire-unwired' fix + Arm A scrutiny P0s (deep-freeze the rule arrays per the file-header contract, lathe-rule polysemy guard for 'turning'/'okuma' bare matches) + Arm A P1-2 (drop \bdrawing\b — too broad) + Arm A P3-2 (apply the same wire-EDM exclusion to AGENT_RULES — exact same bug class).

scripts/lib/rgs-pipeline-rules.test.mjs (22 -> 31 cases; +13 = 5 domain positives + 5 polysemy/freeze guards + 1 mill-turn composite + 1 milligrams edge + 1 agent contrapositive)

units.title: Dispatcher wiring — prism_dev:roadmap_tool_plan_*
units.description: Wire prism_dev:roadmap_tool_plan_{query,build,coverage} actions — the tool-plan sidecar no dispatcher can read is an engine-wiring-doctrine violation. query = pure in-process sidecar JSON read; coverage + build = execFileSync subprocess delegation to the canonical scripts (R8 — they own Ollama/lock/enumeration, no duplication). unit_key charset-guarded [A-Za-z0-9_:.-] in both the Zod schema regex AND a runtime re-check (defense-in-depth; execFileSync is already shell-free). Per-file scrutiny caught a P0 (3 actions missing from the ACTIONS z.enum → MockMCPServer test false-green, the MS0 core-lesson recurring) + a P1 (coverage test could not detect a regression-to-stub on the empty sidecar — added totalOpen>0 anti-stub assertion from envelope enumeration).
deliverables: mcp-server/src/schemas/devActionSchemas.ts (3 ACTION_DEV_SCHEMAS entries — roadmap_tool_plan_{query,build,coverage}; unit_key .regex charset guard + .describe on every field)

mcp-server/src/tools/dispatchers/devDispatcher.ts (3 case branches after roadmap_intel_health; ACTIONS z.enum +3; execFileSync added to the child_process import; query=pure read, coverage/build=execFileSync(process.execPath) subprocess with structured error)

mcp-server/src/__tests__/devDispatcher.rgs-tool-plan-wire.test.ts (NEW — 9 cases: dispatcher guards, charset reject ×2, real-sidecar round-trip, the coverage REAL-subprocess E2E with totalOpen>0 anti-stub, build structured-error path, enum-acceptance sweep)

units.title: Pickup composite-key fallback
units.description: Operators do not type composite MS::unit keys -> picked events never fire -> the feedback loop never accumulates data. pick-prefresh-inject must fall back to active-claim / CURRENT_POSITION.md to resolve the unit key.

units.description: Use prism_ai:xproc_transfer_* to seed cold-start milestones with priors from completed sibling milestones.
